title: With Jalen Hurts sidelined for at least a month, Tanner McKee faces big challenge for Eagles

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: With Jalen Hurts sidelined for at least a month, Tanner McKee faces big challenge for Eagles
sources.description: Tanner McKee is taking over an Eagles offense littered with holes. If things keep going this way, the team might have to switch paths.
